title: Reviewing, editing and confirming your documents
description: Clearing the review queue: the queue is grouped by sender; open a document, check the read against the page, confirm it (it files and drops off), and learn where Defer, Skip and File all ready fit. The field-correction mechanic is explained by hovering, not typed, so no wrong value is taught to the demo data. Assumes documents are waiting after the import video.

steps.narration: Most documents ScanFinder files on its own. Review is where it shows you the few it wasn't completely sure about — so nothing is ever filed wrongly behind your back.
steps.caption: Review: check what it wasn't sure about

steps.narration: Open Review from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Review

steps.narration: Everything waiting is listed on the left, grouped by who sent it. A brand-new supplier has all of its documents here for a first look; a supplier ScanFinder already knows usually just needs a quick confirm or two.
steps.caption: Grouped by sender

steps.narration: Click a sender to open its documents,
steps.caption: 2. Click a sender

steps.narration: and click one to open it up.
steps.caption: 3. Open a document

steps.narration: The scanned page is on the right, and everything ScanFinder read from it is on the left — who sent it, the date, and the reference number. Those three decide where it's filed and what it's named. Anything it's unsure of is highlighted for you.
steps.caption: Page on the right · the read on the left

steps.narration: Your job is simply to check each detail against the page. If something's wrong, click into the field and type what's actually printed — ScanFinder remembers that correction for this sender, so it won't make the same slip twice. If a detail is missing altogether, the small plus button lets you draw a box around it, exactly like teaching.
steps.caption: Wrong? Type it · Missing? ⊕ draw it

steps.narration: When everything matches, click Confirm. The document is filed away into its sender, year and month folder, and that confirmation counts towards ScanFinder trusting this supplier in future.
steps.caption: 4. Confirm — files it and teaches it

steps.narration: The next document loads by itself, so a queue moves quickly — watch the count drop as you work through it.
steps.caption: The next one loads automatically

steps.narration: Not ready to decide on one? Defer keeps it aside for later, and Skip simply jumps past it without filing — nothing is ever lost.
steps.caption: Defer for later · Skip for now

steps.narration: And when several have read cleanly and only need a nod, File all ready deals with them together in one click.
steps.caption: File all ready — the clean ones in one go

steps.narration: That's Review. Every correction you make here teaches ScanFinder, so over time there's less and less to check. Next, we'll teach it a brand-new document.
steps.caption: Next: teach a new document
